Class AnomalyClassifier

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.anomaly.AnomalyClassifier
public final class AnomalyClassifier extends Object
Maps raw SQLExceptions onto the typed CrdbAnomaly hierarchy and decides retryability, based on SQLSTATE.
  • 40001 (serialization_failure) and 40P01 (deadlock) → SerializationConflict — retryable.
  • class 08* (connection exceptions) → ConnectionAnomaly — retryable (a fresh connection may succeed).
  • everything else → UnknownAnomaly — not retryable.
